clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Grunt Logmar watches the southern Barrens frontier for the Horde. He tracks threats near the camp and seeks aid for missing scouts.

At Camp Taurajo, Grunt Logmar guards the Horde's southern Barrens frontier. The camp lies among the tauren, near hostile quilboar grounds and the mountain passes into Stonetalon and Mulgore. Logmar keeps watch over these dangers and coordinates scouting reports. When his comrades are ambushed or captured by local hostiles, he calls on capable Horde travelers to help find and aid them.
